digest.component_or_area: Agent tooling — PreToolUse hook for Bash
propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a non-blocking reminder when the command invokes grep, rg, egrep, or fgrep
The reminder trigger must be a simple string match for grep-family commands with no pattern classification or path heuristics

The reminder message must be 2–3 lines, name find_referencing_symbols as the preferred path, document the string-literal and line-number exceptions for grep, and emit JSON via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext without permissionDecision
The hook must never block execution, deny a call, or exit non-zero, and must remain non-blocking even on malformed input
The hook implementation must live in a tracked script (scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py) and be testable in isolation against the documented PreToolUse stdin envelope
The .claude/settings.json merge must preserve the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting from story C
